INTER-OFFICE CORRESPONDENCE 120 PARK AVENUE, NEW YORK, N.Y 10017
.
TO,
Hamish Maxwell
FROM, George Weissman
DATE January 25, 1991
SUBJECT. TELEPHONE CALL FROM JIM BURKE
Jim Burke, from Partnership for a Drug Free America, just called me to say that he had received my letter, and after thinking about it, has decided not to use the cigarette analogy any more in his speeches, and particularly in a large presentation he is going to make in Washington next week.
He said he may use the cigarette quitting rate sometime in the future, as an indication that people with a will, can stop a habit. But, he would not in any way, compare it to addiction or drug abuse.
He asked me to communicate this to you.
